messages:
ops-bot: ALERT: Hosted API queue in us-west-2 growing rapidly (>5x) for model-redwood-16k. Autoscaler failing to provision GPUs due to quota errors. Current queue length: 12,300. p95 requests latency: 11.6s, p99: 29.4s. Detecting increased 504s. Paging oncall.

sara: Oncall here. Looking.

matt: I see the same in the dashboard — spikes started ~20m ago. Autoscaler logs show: \"ScaleCreateFailed: quotaExceeded for GPUs in us-west-2\". Any cross-region fallback enabled?

jin: fallback policy exists but routes are weighted to us-west for latency. If we switch to multi-region routing now, we might relieve the queue. Possible bump in tail latency for some customers.

emma-support: Customer-reported issues: 3 Fortune customers hitting timeouts, support tickets opened. Ticket IDs: INC-9831, INC-9832. They're seeing 502/504s.

sara: Triage plan: 1) try manual scale-out with admin quota override if possible, 2) enable immediate fallback routing to us-east-1 for burst traffic, 3) apply temporary rate limit to heavy customers. Who can run the admin override?

matt: I can attempt admin-scale but console is returning 403 from cloud provider for quota increase. Need infra approval. Trying CLI now: ```aws ec2 request-limit-increase --resource g4dn --region us-west-2 --amount 40``` Getting: \"Request accepted but pending approval\" — so no immediate lift.

jin: Ok skip quota. I'll flip routing to allow multi-region fallback. Command in our control plane: ```redwood route modify --name hosted-api --fallback-region us-east-1 --policy immediate-failover``` This will route new requests to us-east if us-west queue depth > 2000. Rolling that now.

ops-bot: ACTION: routing change executed by jin at +5m. New requests evaluated against fallback policy.

matt: Also enabling model-variant downgrade for non-SLA traffic: map model-redwood-16k -> model-redwood-8k for free-tier and best-effort customers. Patch deployed to routing config.

emma-support: Sent customer update to impacted accounts: \"We are investigating elevated latency in US West; routing fallback and mitigations are in progress. We'll update in 15m.\" :hourglass_flowing_sand:

sara: Running live checks. Queue length dropped from 12,300 -> 6,100 after fallback enabled. p95 reduced to 4.2s, p99 12.9s. Still high but trending down.

matt: Observed an issue: some large batched jobs were pinned to GPU nodes in us-west and are stuck in eviction loop. We should cancel long-running queued batches older than 10m for best-effort customers. I'll run a cancellation sweep: ```redwood queue reap --older-than 600 --customer-tier best-effort``` Executing.

ops-bot: NOTE: reap job started (job id reap-2024-05-03-01). Estimated to clear ~3k stuck items.

jin: After reap, queue at 2,700. p95 1.9s, p99 6.7s. Looks much better. Need to watch for churn if traffic persists.

sara: Good. Now for long-term mitigation: open a ticket to request permanent quota increase and update autoscaler to fallback to provisioning lower-memory instances when quota limited. I'll create a runbook task.

emma-support: Follow-up to customers with timeline and action items posted. They're asking for ETA on full recovery.

matt: ETA: if traffic stays level, fallback + reap should stabilize within 30m. We'll monitor. Escalating to infra for quota requests. Also scheduling a canary to verify model-downgrade correctness to avoid correctness regressions.

oncall-lead: Handoff note for next oncall: Incident originating 1717554321. Mitigations applied: multi-region fallback enabled, model-variant downgrade for best-effort, queue reap executed. Current status: degraded but stable; queue 2,700; p95 1.9s. Next steps: monitor telemetry for 60m, follow up with cloud quota team, run postmortem, confirm customers notified.

sara: I'll keep monitoring for 45m then handoff. Adding a brief post in #status-updates once p95 < 1s for 15m.

emma-support: Customers ACK'd the update. Two enterprise customers requested credits; routing them to success managers.

matt: Recording logs: autoscaler failure root cause appears to be regional GPU quota exhaustion exacerbated by a sudden traffic burst from a third-party partner. Need to add partner-specific rate-limits in routing.

jin: Agreed. Action items to track: 1) quota request with cloud provider (ticket CP-1222), 2) autoscaler fallback to smaller instance types, 3) partner-specific throttles, 4) automated long-job eviction policy, 5) postmortem.

ops-bot: REMINDER: Incident channel will remain open until incident state is resolved. Please add p0 labels to follow-ups. :rotating_light:

sara: Closing note before handoff: thanks team, great mitigation. I'll update the postmortem skeleton and assign owners. Handoff to matt in 30m.

matt: Taking over. I'll keep this thread updated. If anyone sees a regression, ping me @matt.

ops-bot: INCIDENT: resolved -> monitoring at 1717561200. Final metrics: peak queue 12,300, final stabilized queue 1,100 after continued draining, p95 0.95s, p99 2.8s. Incident Severity: Sev3. Postmortem required.
